biotools.summary: ACEGEN is a toolkit for generative drug design built using TorchRL, streamlining reinforcement learning for molecular generation. It offers a comprehensive and tested approach, validated through benchmarking and applied in multiple drug discovery case studies, and is available under the MIT license.
